label: ADVISORY. AI-written explanation of the QorTime referee's results. It does not decide or change the verdict.
built_during: Meta AI Developer Hackathon, Oct 26 - Nov 4 2026
explanation:
STATUS: VERIFIED

This Madden27 single match on PS5 was recorded by the capture client and checked by referee qortime-online-s2.

Passed: bundle structure, capture chain, challenges, final re-read, input integrity, motion and video bytes. The end-of-game menu re-read matches the claimed final: away wins 10 to 0 in quarter 4, final confirmed. No errors and nothing missing.

Video was spot-checked: 166 of 525 segments checked. Controller input advisory is advisory only, not proof of a human player.

Not proven: who was holding the controller, that the laptop countersignatures were made live, that footage was not edited before hashing, and content of segments not received.
